answer: The wall is Seedkeeper tended bed proof witnessed at the compost tally. Each brick is 3-year garden service, 115 supervised plantings, seed exam, annual garden dues, laid by a different hand, in a different year. The farm's edge dies on cost: 579 separate proofs, each 116 POA, totalling 67164 POA before a single answer counts. A vine earned slowly, a garden paid plainly, and a gale kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. One seat, one proof, one price: the farm cannot buy in bulk.
